facts.fact: 贝阿特丽斯家的镜子藏在楼上墙里的滑动板后，母亲每三个月给她剪一次头发，那时她才被允许照镜子
facts.anchor: I’m allowed to stand in front of it once every three months, when my mother cuts my hair.

facts.fact: 剪发有一套固定流程：她从走廊壁橱搬出凳子，母亲从浴室抽屉拿来剪刀和梳子，她坐下，母亲拉开面板
facts.anchor: It’s the same choreography every time.

facts.fact: 她想起哥哥迦勒（Caleb）多年来自己剪头发，母亲的小笑和梳子的拉扯让她觉得自己像个孩子
facts.anchor: But today I think of my brother, Caleb, how he’s been cutting his own hair for years, and my mother’s small smile and the tug of the comb make me feel like a child.

facts.fact: 她开口要自己剪，母亲只犹豫了一瞬，就把剪刀交到她手里
facts.anchor: She hesitates for only a moment before putting the scissors in my hand.

facts.fact: 她盘算把头发剪到下巴的位置，想着那样自己会不会变成另一个人
facts.anchor: What if I cut my hair at my chin? Could I be someone different then?

facts.fact: 她随即告诉自己：换个发型并不会改变一个人
facts.anchor: A haircut doesn’t change a person.

facts.fact: 她真正想要的是成为「适合这里」的人——属于这个派系、这个家，而不是那个不适合的人
facts.anchor: Desperate to be the person who fits here, in our faction, in our home, instead of the one who doesn’t.

facts.fact: 全章以她合拢剪刀、剪下第一缕头发结束
facts.anchor: I close the scissors over the first lock of hair, and cut.
